description: LAWRENCE, KS — Chris Mann’s campaign for Kansas Attorney General filed another record-breaking fundraising report today, raising nearly $800,000 during the 2026 pre-primary reporting period, bringing the campaign’s total fundraising to $1,324,188 for the cycle. Mann outraised his opponent, Kris Kobach, by more than four to one, and ended the reporting period with more cash […]
